description.zh: 点球大战一触即发！瞄准球门落点、蓄力射门，与守门员展开五轮对决。射偏或力量不当会被扑出，总分战平则进入突然死亡轮，快来刷新最高进球纪录！
description.en: Step up for a penalty shootout! Aim at the goal, charge your shot and beat the keeper over five rounds. Mind your power — a tie sends you to sudden death, so chase your best record!

controls.zh: 点击 / 拖动球门区域瞄准，按住蓄力、松开射门，Esc / P 暂停
controls.en: Click / drag in the goal area to aim, hold to charge and release to shoot, Esc / P to pause
